title: Explicit completed tensor component at one finite rational stage
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme X on which l is invertible, a native ordinary realization R, closed tensor structure closed, its K-flat tensor models models, a finite coefficient field E, and a CompletedTensorFiniteModel N at E. For two objects K,L of the raw rational constructible E-stage, define the stage component as completedTensorIntegralComponent on their underlying integral objects followed by the component of the existing natural commonInclusionTensorComparison whiskered by ordinary. Its source is the closed tensor of the ordinary realizations of the included objects; its target is the ordinary realization of their common-stage tensor.

def completedTensorStageComponent
    (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (N : CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (K L : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X) :
    closed.tensor.obj
      ((ordinary l X R).obj ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
        (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E).obj K),
       (ordinary l X R).obj ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
        (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E).obj L)) ≅
      (ordinary l X R).obj ((commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) X).obj
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E).obj K,
         (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E).obj L))
